deadline.value: Postgraduate research applications are open all year round; no fixed PhD deadline is given on the programme page.
deadline.quote: Postgraduate Research applications are open all year round on our website.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are told to email the prospective supervisor before applying.
supervisor.quote: If you are interested in any of these projects, you should email the prospective supervisor for discussing your intentions.

funding.value: The School has only a limited number of scholarships, which are discussed with the potential supervisor.
funding.quote: The School of Engineering has a limited number of scholarships to offer to excellent candidates, application shall be discussed with the potential supervisor.

entry_route.value: The usual standard is a 2.1 honours degree with a significant electronics or electrical component.
entry_route.quote: Our regular standard of admission is usually a 2.1 honours degree, with a significant component in Electronics and Electrical Engineering.

notes: Applications go through the research division page on the main site. Systems Power and Energy and Autonomous Systems and Connectivity are separate engineering PhD pages and are not recorded here.
